meta.desc: 押题精选 26 道原题 + 配套范文

items.title: 在职群体参加继续学习的目的

blocks.v: The chart above illustrates the purposes of continuing education among working people in a city in 2025. Improving current job skills tops the list at 65%, followed by learning about new fields at 48%. Developing personal interests and obtaining qualifications account for 37% and 26%, respectively. Respondents could select more than one purpose.

A variety of reasons can be cited to account for this phenomenon. First and foremost, changing job requirements encourage employees to update their knowledge and practical skills. Furthermore, learning about new fields may create opportunities for career development. An increasing number of people are also beginning to realize that education can enrich their lives beyond the workplace. The findings therefore suggest that continuing education serves both professional needs and personal aspirations.

We should bear in mind that lifelong learning is of great importance to our personal development. Employers should offer accessible training, while educational institutions should provide flexible courses for working adults. Individuals, in turn, should choose courses that match their actual needs and available time. In this way, learning can become a sustainable habit with lasting benefits.

items.title: 燃油车与新能源汽车国内销量

blocks.v: The table above illustrates domestic sales of conventional and new energy vehicles from January to June 2025. Sales of new energy vehicles rose overall from 0.79 million to 1.12 million, despite a slight decline in April. Conventional vehicle sales fluctuated, peaking at 1.33 million in March. New energy vehicles outsold conventional ones in May, but the latter regained the lead in June.

Several factors may contribute to this pattern. First and foremost, improvements in batteries and charging facilities can make new energy vehicles more attractive to buyers. Furthermore, lower running costs may encourage consumers to consider these models. Meanwhile, conventional vehicles remain appealing to people who value familiar technology or lack convenient access to charging facilities. The figures thus suggest growing competition between the two categories.

We should bear in mind that technological progress is of great importance to the development of the automobile industry. Manufacturers should improve product safety and reliability, while authorities should support convenient charging services. Consumers should compare their actual travel needs and total ownership costs before making a decision.

items.title: 居民日常出行选择

blocks.v: The chart above illustrates changes in daily transport choices in a city between 2015 and 2021. The proportion of residents choosing buses fell from just over 50% to under 30%. Meanwhile, the shares for ride-hailing services and shared bicycles rose to approximately a quarter each. Private cars and other forms of transport recorded smaller declines.

Several factors may contribute to this phenomenon. First and foremost, mobile applications make it easier to arrange a ride or locate a bicycle. Furthermore, shared bicycles offer a convenient option for short journeys, while ride-hailing services can meet more flexible travel needs. The figures suggest that residents have gained a wider range of transport choices.

We should bear in mind that convenience and sustainability are both important to urban transport. Authorities should improve bus services and cycling facilities, while service providers should ensure safety. In this way, residents can enjoy more reliable options for their daily journeys.

items.title: 大学生择业考虑因素

blocks.v: The chart above illustrates the factors considered by students at a university when choosing a job. Personal development prospects top the list at 65%, followed by pay at 53%. Company reputation is mentioned by 31%, while personal interests and the working environment receive 22% and 9%, respectively.

Several factors contribute to this phenomenon. First and foremost, graduates need opportunities to acquire skills and build a sustainable career, which helps explain the emphasis on development prospects. Furthermore, pay matters because young employees must meet their daily expenses and gradually achieve financial independence. A well-known employer may also appear to offer valuable experience and recognition. Nevertheless, the relatively low figures for interests and the working environment deserve attention, since both can influence motivation and job satisfaction.

We should bear in mind that a suitable job should support both immediate needs and long-term development. Universities should offer practical career guidance, and students should learn about actual duties before accepting an offer. By considering their abilities, interests and future goals together, graduates can make better-informed choices about their working lives.

items.title: 全国便利店门店数量

blocks.v: The chart above illustrates the growth in the number of convenience stores in China from 2015 to 2023. The total rose from roughly 90,000 to approximately 320,000. Growth was relatively modest up to 2019 and became considerably faster thereafter, indicating the expansion of this retail sector.

A variety of reasons can be cited to account for this phenomenon. First and foremost, busy urban lifestyles create demand for nearby shops where people can purchase daily necessities quickly. Furthermore, longer opening hours and a convenient range of products make these stores attractive to consumers. Improvements in distribution networks and inventory management may also help businesses operate more efficiently and open additional outlets. Together, these factors offer possible explanations for the rising number of stores.

We should bear in mind that service quality is of great importance to the sustainable development of the retail industry. Operators should ensure food safety, maintain reasonable prices and adapt their products to local needs. Careful planning is also necessary to avoid excessive competition in the same neighborhood. In this way, expansion can bring lasting benefits to both businesses and consumers.

items.title: 新生朋辈指导项目：介绍与回复

blocks.v: Dear Michael,
Thanks for your email. I am writing to tell you more about our peer mentoring program for new students.

The details can be listed as follows. Each new student is paired with a senior student who offers advice on courses and campus life. Weekly meetings provide opportunities to discuss study methods and share experiences. Group activities also help you make friends and become familiar with university services. You can register at the department office before Friday.
For more information about the program, please do not hesitate to contact me. I hope you will find it helpful.
Yours sincerely,
Li Ming

items.title: 中国文化演讲：建议与安排

blocks.v: Dear Jane,
I was delighted to receive your email about the speech contest. I am writing to offer some suggestions.

I would highly recommend Chinese tea culture for its rich history and close connection with daily life. You could explain how serving tea expresses hospitality and share a personal experience. Including a simple example would make your speech more engaging. As for our video call, would 7 p.m. Beijing time this Saturday be convenient for you?
Please let me know whether this time suits you. I am looking forward to hearing from you soon.
Yours sincerely,
Li Ming

items.title: 学习工具推荐：建议与说明

blocks.v: Dear Alex,
I hope this email finds you well. Knowing that you are looking for AI learning tools, I am writing to recommend ChatGPT to you.

I would highly recommend it for its flexibility and interactive features. You can ask it to explain difficult concepts, generate practice questions or give feedback on your English writing. Follow-up questions can also help you examine points you do not understand. However, please check important information against reliable sources and complete your own work independently.
I hope you will find this recommendation helpful. I am looking forward to hearing about your experience.
Yours sincerely,
Li Ming

items.title: 接机计划变更：道歉与建议

blocks.v: Dear James,

I am writing to apologize for being unable to pick you up at the airport this Saturday. I have just been informed of a compulsory examination that morning. To make sure your arrival goes smoothly, I have asked my roommate to meet you instead. He will wait at the arrivals exit with a sign bearing your name and take you to your hotel. I will send you his phone number and confirm your flight details with him in advance.
Please accept my sincere apology for any inconvenience this change may cause. I look forward to seeing you after the examination.
Yours sincerely,
Li Ming

items.title: 海外学习帮助：感谢与邀请

blocks.v: Dear Professor Thomas,
I am writing to express my gratitude for your kind assistance during my summer study program abroad.

Your advice on my research and your help with library resources were invaluable. Without your generous help, I would not have had such a wonderful experience. I also learned a great deal from our discussions about different cultures. I wonder if you could visit China during your next holiday so that I can show you some historical sites and introduce you to local traditions. Thank you again for your support. I am looking forward to hearing from you soon.
Yours sincerely,
Li Ming

items.title: 文化交流中心志愿者：申请与说明

blocks.v: Dear Sir or Madam,
As a university student majoring in English, I am writing to apply for a volunteer position at the Center for Cultural Interchange.

I believe I am well qualified for this position. First, my good command of English allows me to communicate effectively with international visitors. Moreover, I have helped organize cultural activities on campus and gained experience in welcoming guests and coordinating schedules. I am patient, responsible and enthusiastic about promoting mutual understanding. I am available at weekends.
Thank you for considering my application. I would be grateful for an opportunity to discuss my qualifications in an interview.
Yours sincerely,
Li Ming

items.title: 文化旅游协会：志愿者招募通知

blocks.v: Notice
November 20, 2026
We are pleased to announce that the Cultural and Tourism Association is recruiting student volunteers.

Applicants should be interested in local culture, communicate clearly and work well in a team. Selected volunteers will guide visitors, introduce cultural attractions and assist with campus exhibitions. Volunteers will work from 9 a.m. to noon every Saturday in December. Training will be provided before the first shift.

This is an ideal opportunity to contribute to cultural exchange while gaining valuable experience. Please register at the association office by November 28. We are looking forward to your enthusiastic participation.
Cultural and Tourism Association

items.title: 防止食物浪费：会议纪要

blocks.v: Minutes of Meeting
Date: November 10, 2026
Location: Room 201
Objective: Preventing food waste
Attendees: All class members
The meeting aimed to discuss food waste in daily life and find practical solutions. Participants identified oversized portions and unnecessary purchases as common causes.

As a concrete measure, the meeting decided that students should order smaller portions, plan purchases carefully and store leftovers properly. Members also agreed to display posters in the dining hall and remind one another to avoid waste. The meeting concluded with an agreement to review progress the following month. Recorded by: Li Ming

items.title: 公共场所无障碍通道的普及

blocks.v: The cartoon above depicts a wheelchair user approaching a public building by an accessible route, while the chart illustrates improvements in accessibility. The proportion of public places with accessible routes in a city rose steadily from 56% in 2021 to 85% in 2025. Together, the two images highlight progress toward a more inclusive society.

Several factors may contribute to this phenomenon. First and foremost, an increasing number of people are beginning to realize that equal participation requires accessible facilities. Furthermore, better planning and investment can help remove physical barriers in public spaces. Not only do ramps and lifts make travel easier for people with disabilities, but they also benefit older adults and others with limited mobility. Such improvements protect dignity as well as provide practical convenience.

We should bear in mind that accessibility is of great importance to social progress. Authorities should extend these facilities to more locations and ensure that existing routes remain unobstructed and well maintained. Listening to users can also reveal problems that designers might overlook. Only through sustained attention can accessible facilities become reliable support in everyday life.

items.title: 急救知识的普及

blocks.v: The cartoon above depicts a person teaching others a basic first-aid skill, while the chart illustrates growing participation in first-aid training. In a city, the proportion of residents aged 18 to 60 who received such training increased steadily from 9% in 2021 to 32% in 2025. These materials highlight the spread of practical knowledge of emergency response.

Several factors may contribute to this phenomenon. First and foremost, an increasing number of people are beginning to realize that timely assistance can make a difference in an emergency. Furthermore, accessible courses offered by communities and workplaces may encourage more residents to participate. Not only does practical training improve relevant skills, but it also helps participants understand their limits and respond with greater confidence. However, the figures show that participation still has considerable room to grow.

We should bear in mind that first-aid education is of great importance to public safety. Qualified instructors should provide practical courses, and participants should refresh their knowledge regularly. Only through the joint efforts of communities, employers and individuals can essential emergency skills become more widely available.

items.title: 留学人员回国发展

blocks.v: The cartoon above depicts overseas students returning to China, while the chart below illustrates the growth in their numbers. The annual number of returning students increased from 134,800 in 2010 to 600,000 in 2019, rising to more than four times its initial level. Together, the materials highlight the growing appeal of returning home after studying abroad.

A variety of reasons can be cited to account for this phenomenon. First and foremost, developments in research, technology and business may provide attractive career opportunities in China. Furthermore, returning students can apply what they have learned abroad while benefiting from their familiarity with the local language and culture. The wish to live closer to family may also influence their decisions. These professional and personal considerations can jointly shape their plans.

We should bear in mind that talented individuals are of great importance to national development. Employers should provide fair recruitment procedures and opportunities for professional growth, while returnees should adapt their knowledge to practical needs. Universities and businesses can also encourage international cooperation. In this way, overseas experience can contribute to innovation and mutual understanding.

items.title: 中国人平均寿命与人口老龄化

blocks.v: The charts above illustrate changes in life expectancy and population aging in China. Average life expectancy rose from 72.54 years in 2004 to 79 years in 2024. Meanwhile, the proportion of people aged 60 and above increased from 10.97% to 22%, slightly more than doubling.

Several factors may help explain these trends. Better living conditions and healthcare can enable people to live longer. Meanwhile, lower birth rates can gradually reduce the relative size of younger generations. The figures thus reflect improvements in longevity while highlighting the need for stronger support for an aging population.

We should bear in mind that care for older adults is of great importance to social well-being. Authorities should improve healthcare and community services, while families should provide companionship. Opportunities for older people to participate in social activities also deserve attention. Such efforts can make longer lives healthier and more fulfilling.

items.title: 冰激凌线上与线下销售占比

blocks.v: The pie charts above illustrate the shares of online and offline ice cream sales in China in 2020 and 2021. The online share rose from 5% to 20%, while the offline share fell from 95% to 80%. Although online sales gained 15 percentage points, offline purchases remained dominant.

Several factors may contribute to this phenomenon. First and foremost, online platforms allow consumers to compare products and place orders without visiting a shop. Furthermore, improvements in refrigerated delivery can make it easier to transport frozen products to customers. Promotional offers may also encourage people to try this purchasing method. Nevertheless, physical stores still provide immediate access to ice cream, which helps explain their continued importance. The figures suggest that businesses should take both channels into account when planning their sales strategies.

We should bear in mind that convenience must be accompanied by reliable service. Businesses should ensure appropriate storage and delivery conditions and provide clear product information. Combining dependable online services with accessible physical stores can meet different consumer needs and support the sustainable development of the industry.

items.title: 人工智能工具的使用

blocks.v: The cartoon above presents us with a thought-provoking scene: a student is delighted with an AI tool that has generated answers to his homework. The caption suggests that the assignment is already complete. The drawing invites us to reflect on whether finishing a task necessarily means learning something.

There is no doubt that artificial intelligence can make learning more efficient. Not only does it provide quick explanations, but it also enables students to explore unfamiliar subjects. However, we cannot ignore the fact that excessive dependence on ready-made answers may weaken independent thinking. If students simply submit generated content without checking or understanding it, they miss the opportunity to develop their own abilities. Moreover, inaccurate answers may mislead users who lack sufficient knowledge to evaluate them.

We should bear in mind that independent thinking is of great importance to our personal development. Students should attempt problems first and use AI to review their reasoning. Teachers should also explain the proper boundaries of its use. Only through the joint efforts of teachers and students can we turn technological convenience into meaningful educational progress.

items.title: “陪着”不等于“陪伴”

blocks.v: As is symbolically depicted in the cartoon above, a father sits beside his son but keeps his eyes on his mobile phone. The boy asks whether his father is listening. The caption beneath the drawing reminds us that being physically present does not necessarily mean providing real companionship.

What is clearly conveyed in the picture is that family relationships require attention and communication. For one thing, children need opportunities to share their experiences and feelings with their parents. Careful listening helps them feel understood and supported. For another, frequent distractions may discourage children from speaking openly, gradually weakening mutual trust. A parent who repeatedly chooses a screen over a conversation also sets an example that children may follow in their own relationships.

We should bear in mind that meaningful companionship is of great importance to family life. Parents should put their phones aside during meals and conversations and make time for activities with their children. Such changes do not necessarily require much money or elaborate plans. Only through consistent attention and patient communication can we build closer and more lasting family bonds.

items.title: 压力与身心健康

blocks.v: Depicted in the picture above is a scene that strikes us as both familiar and thought-provoking: a man sits at a desk with his head lowered, surrounded by documents and reminders. The word "pressure" appears prominently above him. The drawing highlights the burden that excessive stress can place on daily life.

Several factors contribute to this phenomenon. First and foremost, demanding schedules and intense competition may leave people with little time to rest. Furthermore, some people set unrealistic expectations for themselves and regard every setback as a personal failure. We cannot ignore the fact that prolonged stress can harm both physical and mental health. It may also reduce concentration and efficiency, making unfinished tasks even harder to manage.

It is not difficult to draw the conclusion that enough attention must be paid to stress management. Individuals should set reasonable priorities, take regular breaks and seek support when necessary. Employers should also distribute tasks fairly and respect reasonable working hours. Only through the joint efforts of individuals and organizations can we achieve a healthier balance between productive work and personal well-being.

items.title: 过度包装与绿色消费

blocks.v: The cartoon above presents us with a thought-provoking scene: a person stands beside a pile of boxes and wonders why buying one gift requires so much packaging. The contrast between the small purchase and the large amount of wrapping highlights the problem of excessive packaging.

Several factors contribute to this phenomenon. For one thing, some businesses use elaborate packages to make ordinary products appear more valuable. For another, some consumers associate attractive wrapping with quality or respect for the recipient. However, we cannot ignore the fact that unnecessary packaging consumes resources and creates waste. It also adds to the price consumers pay, while offering little practical benefit once the product has been opened.

We should bear in mind that responsible consumption is of great importance to environmental protection. Businesses should use simple packaging that protects products effectively, and consumers should pay more attention to usefulness than to appearance. Authorities can encourage recyclable materials and discourage wasteful practices. If these proposed measures are implemented, a harmonious balance between commercial development and environmental protection will be within our reach.

items.title: 网络信息与理性辨别

blocks.v: As is symbolically depicted in the cartoon above, a confused man faces a computer surrounded by conflicting messages. The caption points to the difficulty of distinguishing reliable online information from falsehoods. The drawing raises an important question about honesty and judgment in the digital age.

Several factors contribute to this phenomenon. First and foremost, information can spread rapidly online before anyone has checked its accuracy. Furthermore, some content creators exaggerate facts or invent stories to attract attention. We cannot ignore the fact that misleading messages may influence personal decisions and damage public trust. Without the habit of examining evidence, users may unintentionally help false information reach a wider audience by sharing it with others.

We should bear in mind that honesty is of great importance to online communication. Users should check sources, compare reports and avoid forwarding doubtful claims. Content creators should take responsibility for accuracy, while platforms should make corrections visible and provide effective reporting channels. Only through the joint efforts of users, creators and platforms can we build an online environment in which reliable information receives the attention it deserves.

items.title: 中国传统艺术的传承

blocks.v: The pictures above present us with thought-provoking scenes of traditional Chinese art being passed on. In the first picture, an older artist demonstrates a traditional skill to a young learner. In the second, the younger generation shares and practices the art. The caption emphasizes the importance of preserving this cultural inheritance.

There is no doubt that traditional arts are valuable resources for cultural development. For one thing, they embody the knowledge, creativity and experience of earlier generations. Learning these skills helps young people understand the culture behind familiar designs and objects. For another, direct teaching enables techniques that are difficult to record in words to survive. Without new learners and opportunities for practice, even highly respected forms of art may gradually disappear from everyday life.

We should bear in mind that cultural inheritance requires active participation. Schools and communities should invite skilled artists to offer practical workshops, while young people should approach these traditions with curiosity and patience. Thoughtful innovation can also connect traditional skills with contemporary needs. In this way, cultural heritage can remain a living source of inspiration for future generations.

items.title: 热门与热爱

blocks.v: The pictures above present two considerations when choosing a major. In the first, a student is attracted by strong market demand and promising career prospects. In the second, another student expresses enthusiasm for a particular subject. The contrast invites us to reflect on the relationship between popularity and personal interest.

There is no doubt that both considerations deserve attention. For one thing, employment prospects matter because higher education should help students prepare for their future working lives. For another, genuine interest can encourage sustained effort, especially when learning becomes difficult. We cannot ignore the fact that a currently popular major may lose its advantage as economic conditions change. Equally, enthusiasm alone cannot replace a realistic understanding of course requirements and professional opportunities.

We should bear in mind that a suitable choice is of great importance to personal development. Students should assess their interests and abilities, investigate the curriculum and seek advice from teachers and professionals. Universities should also provide clear information about different paths. By combining self-knowledge with careful research, young people can choose a direction that supports both meaningful learning and future employment.

items.title: 旅游发展与环境保护

blocks.v: The pictures above present a striking contrast between a scenic area in the past and the same place today. The earlier scene features a peaceful natural landscape, whereas the later one shows crowded tourist facilities, numerous boats and scattered rubbish. The contrast highlights the environmental cost of poorly managed tourism.

Several factors contribute to this problem. First and foremost, a rapid increase in visitor numbers can place pressure on natural resources and waste disposal facilities. Furthermore, some operators focus on immediate income while giving insufficient attention to environmental protection. We cannot ignore the fact that careless behavior by individual tourists can also damage the landscape. If these problems continue, the area may lose the very qualities that originally attracted visitors.

By no means should we give up our efforts to protect the environment. Authorities should manage visitor numbers and improve waste collection, while operators should adopt responsible business practices. Tourists should also avoid littering and respect local rules. If these proposed measures are implemented, a harmonious balance between tourism development and environmental protection will be within our reach.
